description:
Hi,

I hope you are doing good.

I have a job opportunity related to your profile with one of our client, please find below Job Description for your review. If you are interested and available for the following position then please send your updated resume in word format along with your contact details to discuss further.

 Role: Technology Analyst - Java UI
Duration:Full TIme
Location:Cranston, RI


Qualifications Basic 
• Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education.
• At least 2 years of experience with Information Technology.

 Preferred 
• At least 2 years of experience with Front-end Web Development, HTML/Java Scripts/CSS Core web Concepts like Statelessness, request/response, J2EE, Struts, EJB and Oracle 
• At least 2 years of experience to develop functional, technical and user interface designs for an application. Interfacing with Back-end applications through RESTful services and JSON. Quick and efficient Problem solving Skills with Financial service domain expertise.
• At least 2 years of experience in UI build tools Grunt or Gulp.
• Linting and minification build concepts, JavaScript unit testing with latest tools and libraries/frameworks like Jasmine, Karma or Mocha. Node.js
• Basic design experience Skills and high level Skills in debugging HTML5 applications using browser tools.
• At least 2 years of experience in web applications that use responsive design to better support mobile browsers.
• Experience in CSS architectural concepts such as SMACSS or OO CSS and tools like SASS or LESS and Framework such as Bootstrap or Foundation.
• JavaScript, using the latest tools and libraries/frameworks such as Backbone, Angular, Require or Browserify.
• Ability to work in team environment and client interfacing skills.
• Analytical skills 
• Experience and desire to work in a Global delivery environment


 • Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education.


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
